task_definition.task_description: Please reserve 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones in black for me, check the current time in New York, then use that reservation to prepare checkout with my credit card and place the order. After that, create a summary document with the reservation, checkout, and confirmed order details and send me an in-app notification.

user_input.query: Please reserve 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones for me using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and check the current time in New York using timezone America/New_York. After the order is confirmed, create a summary document titled Trip Summary that includes the reservation, checkout, and confirmed order details, tag it with finance and travel, and send me an in-app notification.
